CAMERA: 35mm cinema lens, LOCKED-OFF WIDE for the entire shot, tripod bolted down. The camera never moves, never zooms, never pushes in, never gets closer, never cuts to a close-up. The counter and the room stay wide in frame from the first frame to the last; every object stays the same size on screen.
LOOK: match the reference frame's grade EXACTLY: dim night interior kept very dark, heavily desaturated near-monochrome, deep grey shadows, no daylight, no bright walls, real film grain. The ONLY colored element in the entire video is one tiny highlighter-yellow point at the fingertip.
STYLE: cinematic brand film, slow, held, precise. No glow, no neon, no lens flare, no light particles: every dot is a matte physical grain, like a halftone made of real grains.
CHARACTER: NO FACE anywhere, no head, no body, no person, no second person, nobody walks through frame. The only human presence is ONE right hand and forearm in a plain dark sweater sleeve, made of thousands of small matte grey grains gathered into the shape of a hand. Same hand and same dark sweater in every shot. The hand never walks away and never leaves toward the back of the room.
SETTING: a hospital nurses' station at night, completely empty of people, seen wide across the whole counter. A document tray sits on the counter and one small distant monitor sits far back on the desk. The blank grid board on the far wall stays dark and untouched for the whole shot.
CONSTRAINT: absolutely no letters, no words, no numbers, no signage, no handwriting, no typing of text. Screens show ONLY a few large solid grey bars on a plain background: no axis labels, no tick marks, no legend, no caption, no window chrome, no icons, no toolbars. No labelled bottles, no printed documents, no posters, no labels, no logos, no watermarks, no subtitles. Nothing is ever written or spelled. No colored element besides the single yellow point.

2. (~2s, identical wide framing, camera does not move) The grains GATHER into a right hand and dark-sleeved forearm above the counter. The hand takes one blank sheet of paper and slides it down into the document tray.
3. (~2s, identical wide framing, camera still does not move, the small monitor stays far away and small) On that distant screen a row of large solid grey blocks fills in one by one. Then the hand loosens back into grains and streams out of the right edge along the lines.
